Use case: precise-object-edit. Make Kazi's run COMPACT without changing his approved illustrated identity or longer slim curved sword.
Image 1 is the current RUN SHEET edit target. Image 2 is the approved neutral character in the same view and the HEAD/TORSO PROPORTION authority. Image 3 is the identity and long thin curved sword reference. Face east (straight right) with the original weapon hand.
Exactly 18 frames, 6 equal columns x 3 equal rows, one seamless full left/right run cycle. Preserve the same stern marked face, skull/head height and hair silhouette from image 2, charcoal split coat, white collar, gold buttons, trousers, boots, purple sparks and thin long curved blade. Change the running poses so they no longer look horizontally stretched, huge, or like an exaggerated long lunge.
Use a more upright torso (about 5-8 degrees lean), natural compact arms close to the torso, normal limb lengths. Keep the head outline/size from the neutral view; do NOT widen or fan the hair into a long aerodynamic shape. Reduce trailing coat/hair extension by about half versus image 1. The coat follows the body rather than extending as a long horizontal banner. Shorter, tighter leg reach: forward heel and rear toe each extend no farther than about 15% of standing body height from the hips. Preserve the long sword itself; compact the hand position close to his hip instead of shortening the blade.
Frame 0 LEFT heel contact slightly in front; frame 1 planted foot passes under hip; frame 2 travels behind hip; frame 3 rear toe-off. Frames 4,5,6,7,8 tuck/recover the left knee/boot forward naturally, opposite arm counter-swing. Frame 9 RIGHT heel contact; 10 passes beneath hip; 11 behind; 12 rear toe-off. Frames 13,14,15,16,17 recover the right knee/boot into the next frame 0 contact. Each planted foot travels steadily backward while its sole stays at one common floor baseline. In front/back/diagonal views foreshorten this same compact cycle. Eighteen distinct poses, no long holds, no slide-in-place feet fixed under torso.
Keep body/hip and head heights very steady: tiny natural bob below 1.5% of body height, no hops or exaggerated knee bounces. Same character proportions and uniform scale in every frame/row/direction. Preserve the shorter profile width through compact posing, NEVER by squashing the image or scaling the head sideways.
Exactly the same 6x3 grid/canvas aspect as image 1, same sharp illustrated style. At least 20 clear transparent pixels inside every cell boundary around body, limbs, longer sword and ALL sparks. Fit all art uniformly within cells, no clipping or neighbor overlap. True transparent alpha zero background, no haze, floor, ground shadows, grid, numbers, labels, extra frames or watermark.
